extensions.name: brightspace
extensions.description: Your own Brightspace (D2L) MCP server: agents read your courses, assignments, grades, announcements, discussions and course content. It only reads; nothing is submitted or posted.

extensions.name: google-workspace
extensions.description: Google Docs, Sheets and Slides for your agents, plus Drive to find files: search and read anything in the account, write documents as markdown, create files, and comment.

extensions.name: notion
extensions.description: Notion's hosted MCP server: search, read and edit pages, databases and comments in a workspace you choose. Sign in with Notion; nothing to set up.

extensions.name: t3code
extensions.description: Your own T3 Code server: agents read, start, message and stop T3 threads and projects. One connection per T3 server, signed in with a T3 pairing code.

extensions.name: whoop
extensions.description: Your WHOOP recovery, sleep, strain and workouts, with the WHOOP dashboard's trends and insights, read live from WHOOP with your own WHOOP app.
